dedupe_keys.name: acia500 500 m annual cropping intensity for monsoon asia 2001 2020 modis

description: ACIA500 maps annual cropping intensity, the number of crop cycles a field carries each year, on a 500 m grid for monsoon Asia (some countries) from 2001 to 2021, based on MODIS data. The Zenodo record says the files are yearly GeoTIFFs in EPSG:4326 and adds a disclaimer on boundaries. It was first published on 29 September 2021 by Jichong Han, Zhao Zhang, Yuchuan Luo, Juan Cao, Liangliang Zhang, Fei Cheng, Huimin Zhuang and Jing Zhang, with versions to July 2022, as one ZIP of about 5 MB per year, downloadable and free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is part of monsoon Asia; the list of countries and the accuracy are not stated on the page read. Caveats: 500 m cells mix small fields, so intensity is approximate in fragmented landscapes. For simulation it shows where double and triple cropping depends on irrigation and timely monsoon rains, useful for drought, flood and irrigation supply disruption scenarios and for food production exposure. Related catalogue records include the Unified Cropland Layer and the CLIMADA crop production exposure data.
name: ACIA500 - 500 m annual cropping intensity for monsoon Asia, 2001-2021 (MODIS)
